Rescuer.description: A volunteer member of the mountain rescue team. A first name alone is not an identity.

SearchDog.description: A search dog on the team roster, independent of who handles or trains it.

Location.description: A named place on the hill where callouts and exercises happen.

Handling.description:
Who works with a search dog: its handler on searches or its trainer.
Training a dog is not handling it on a search.

Crew.description: How two rescuers stand on the hill: a buddy pair, a team leader over a member, or a deputy standing in for a leader.

Callout.description: One emergency callout to a place. coordinator runs it from base, first_on_scene reached the casualty first, stretcher_lead leads the carry.

Exercise.description: A training exercise held at a place.

messages.text: Callout to Blackscar Gully completed at dusk: 2 casualties, no helicopter needed, with Nkechi Obi coordinating and Gustavo Pereira first on scene.

facts.in: Callout to Blackscar Gully completed at dusk

messages.text: Debrief notes: Eilidh Brannigan is team leader for Jarek Novak this winter. Eilidh MacRae is his buddy. Eilidh wants the radios charged tonight.

facts.in: Eilidh MacRae is his buddy.

messages.text: Anouk de Wit said on the radio: "I am not the handler for Corrie, Rangi is."

messages.text:
Hi Gustavo,
Could you plan an exercise at Hollin Ridge for Saturday, 4 hours, led by Nkechi Obi?
Cheers,
Jarek Novak

facts.in: Could you plan an exercise at Hollin Ridge for Saturday, 4 hours, led by Nkechi Obi?

messages.text: I told the hut warden: "Tessel stays in the kennel until Anouk gets back."
quotes: Tessel stays in the kennel until Anouk gets back.

messages.text: The Raven Crag callout is still active; Rangi Tawhiri is coordinating, the helicopter is already overhead, and conditions are low cloud and sleet.

messages.text: If the weather clears, Corrie will start sessions with Eilidh Brannigan as her trainer. Rangi Tawhiri would then partner Anouk de Wit.

messages.text: The exercise at Raven Crag tomorrow is cancelled; Jarek will tell the team.

messages.text:
From: Nkechi Obi, radio channel 7
My pager battery is dying, please swap it before the next callout.
Callout to Hollin Ridge stood down: Jarek Novak coordinated, Anouk de Wit was first on scene and Gustavo Pereira led the stretcher.

questions.q: Who is the handler of Bracken?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:SearchDog)-[:handler]->(n1:Rescuer) WHERE n0.dog_name = 'Bracken' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: eilidh_m
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)-[:dog]->(n1:SearchDog) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.dog_name AS dog_name

questions.speaker: jarek
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)-[:team_leader]->(n1:Rescuer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: What is the name of the trainee of Rangi Tawhiri?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)-[:trainee]->(n1:SearchDog) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Rangi Tawhiri' RETURN n1.dog_name AS dog_name

questions.q: Who is the deputy of Gustavo Pereira?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)-[:deputy]->(n1:Rescuer) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Gustavo Pereira' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Is there a record of a helicopter on the Blackscar Gully callout?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Location)<-[:location]-(n1:Callout) WHERE n0.place_name = 'Blackscar Gully' RETURN coalesce(n1.helicopter_used, false) AS helicopter_used

questions.q: Was a helicopter used on the Raven Crag callout?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Location)<-[:location]-(n1:Callout) WHERE n0.place_name = 'Raven Crag' RETURN n1.helicopter_used AS helicopter_used

questions.q: How many casualties were there on callouts I coordinated?
questions.speaker: nkechi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)<-[:coordinator]-(n1:Callout) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.casualties AS casualties

questions.q: Who was first on scene at callouts coordinated by Jarek Novak?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)<-[:coordinator]-(n1:Callout)-[:first_on_scene]->(n2:Rescuer) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Jarek Novak' RETURN n2.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many hours did the exercise led by Eilidh MacRae take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)<-[:led_by]-(n1:Exercise) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Eilidh MacRae' RETURN n1.hours AS hours

questions.q: What state is the callout in the sleet?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Callout) WHERE n0.conditions CONTAINS 'sleet' RETURN n0.state AS state

questions.q: List each exercise status and its hours.
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Exercise) RETURN n0.status AS status, n0.hours AS hours

questions.q: What radio channel is Nkechi Obi on?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Nkechi Obi' RETURN n0.radio_channel AS radio_channel

questions.q: Who led the stretcher at Hollin Ridge?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Location)<-[:location]-(n1:Callout)-[:stretcher_lead]->(n2:Rescuer) WHERE n0.place_name = 'Hollin Ridge' RETURN n2.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Who is in the squad of Eilidh Brannigan?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rescuer)-[:squad]->(n1:Rescuer) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Eilidh Brannigan' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
